mr_title: Comments panel appears without having GHPR installed

expected_issues.title: Listeners registered again for every comment controller
expected_issues.description:
Two event listeners are registered on the class-level DisposableStore every time $registerCommentController is called, so they accumulate for the lifetime of MainThreadComments (listener leak, repeated registerView calls).

$registerCommentController is invoked once per comment controller registered by any extension, and controllers can be registered and disposed repeatedly. Registering the listeners with this._register() in that method ties them to the main-thread object, not the controller, so every registration adds two more listeners that are never removed (VS Code's leak detector eventually warns). Listeners that do not depend on the controller belong in the constructor.
